decisions.claim: B is not available on Saturday evening
decisions.reason: A's 'What a pity!' in turn 3 is a direct presuppositional response to B declining Saturday evening, making B's unavailability on Saturday evening a well-grounded inference.

decisions.claim: B is not available on Sunday
decisions.reason: A's turn 5 ('Then when do you think we could go out together?') presupposes that Sunday was also rejected by B, since A moves past both Saturday and Sunday to ask for an alternative time.

decisions.claim: B proposed Friday as a time to go out together
decisions.reason: A's 'OK' in turn 7 signals acceptance of a suggestion made by B, and the content 'Any time on Friday will be OK with me' confirms B proposed Friday as the meeting time.

decisions.claim: B proposed Friday as a time they could go out together
decisions.reason: c4 and c3 refer to the same event (B proposing Friday) with only trivial phrasing differences; they are bidirectionally equivalent at the claimed granularity.
